news.title: SpaceX raising $75 billion in record-setting IPO as Nasdaq debut awaits
news.detail: SpaceX is selling 555.6 shares at $135 a piece, raising $75 billion in the largest IPO on record.

insight.what: SpaceX创纪录750亿美元IPO定价，纳斯达克上市在即
insight.assets: 📈 美股科技股 利好；📈 太空概念股 利好
insight.chain: IPO抽血效应（资金从二级市场流向一级市场）可能短期压制大盘流动性，但提振风险偏好（Risk-on情绪）
insight.watch: IPO首日涨幅及成交量是否超预期

news.title: Stock futures tick higher as Wall Street gears up for SpaceX’s historic IPO: Live updates
news.detail: Elon Musk's rocket maker is set to debut on the Nasdaq on Friday in what will be the largest IPO in history.

insight.what: 华尔街乐观情绪推高股指期货，等待SpaceX历史性IPO
insight.assets: 📈 标普500期货 利好；📈 纳斯达克100期货 利好
insight.chain: IPO情绪外溢（溢出效应）至科技板块，但需警惕‘买预期卖事实’（利多出尽）回调
insight.watch: 开盘后标普500与纳指实际走势是否延续期货涨幅

news.title: Warren questions SpaceX IPO oversight in new letter to stock indexes
news.detail: Sen. Elizabeth Warren seeking answers on changes to index provider waiting periods, protections for retail investors, in a letter obtained first by CNBC.

insight.what: 参议员沃伦质疑SpaceX IPO监管，致信指数公司
insight.assets: 📉 SpaceX估值 承压；📉 监管敏感股 利空
insight.chain: 政治风险（反垄断/监管审查）可能拖累IPO定价，并引发对科技巨头上市审查加严的担忧
insight.watch: SEC是否对SpaceX信息披露展开调查

news.title: SpaceX cuts retail IPO allocation to low 20% range, source says
news.detail: The Elon Musk-led company plans to direct a percentage in the low 20s of the offering to retail buyers, according to a person familiar with the matter.

insight.what: SpaceX削减散户IPO配售比例至20%出头
insight.assets: 📉 散户交易平台 利空；📈 机构投资者 利好
insight.chain: 散户参与度降低（减少打新套利空间）可能抑制首日炒作热情，利好长期持有者
insight.watch: 散户认购倍数与首日换手率数据

news.title: SpaceX IPO won’t ‘break’ the bull market. But investors are worried about what comes next
news.detail: As far as Wall Street is concerned, the stock market has what it takes to absorb the new supply.

insight.what: SpaceX IPO不会终结牛市，但投资者担忧后续风险
insight.assets: 📉 大盘指数 中性偏空；📉 高估值成长股 承压
insight.chain: 若IPO后资金流出（流动性收紧）叠加美联储鹰派（偏向加息）信号，可能触发科技股回调
insight.watch: 美联储议息会议纪要及美债收益率曲线（长短期利率差）变化

news.title: SpaceX确定IPO发行价，募资近750亿美元创史上最大规模纪录
news.detail: SpaceX IPO发行价正式确定，募资金额创史上最高纪录。当地时间6月11日，SpaceX 提交给美国证监会的文件显示，该公司IPO的公开发行价为每股135美元，将发行5.556亿股...

news.title: 韩国央行行长再次暗示加息以缓解通胀压力
news.detail: 韩国央行行长申铉松周五重申，在即将召开的货币政策会议上，有必要提高关键利率，以缓解因中东冲突持续而加剧的通胀压力。

news.title: Gold slumps to 6-month low even as inflation fears rise. Here's why bullion is out of favor
news.detail: The yellow metal is at its lowest level of the year as potential interest rate increases and faltering technical signals weigh on prices.

news.title: 日韩股市高开 韩股开盘暴涨6.4%
news.detail: 日经225指数高开1.5%，报65176.23点，全市场个股普涨。韩国综合股价指数（KOSPI）开盘上涨6.4%，至8263.85点。

news.detail: 美股周四大幅上升，美国总统特朗普宣布，美伊有望达成停火协议，中东战事局势缓和，带动大市气氛向好，美股三大指数收市均录得显著升幅。
